verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's REST API can list registered clients and retrieve session history so the data can be used in third-party systems, and its official open-source Python module can export session data to CSV, an open format. This covers only some account data, not a documented export of everything followed by leaving. missing for 10: a documented all-data/account export (e.g. address books, users, roles, custom client configs), a first-party export feature beyond API scripting, explicit data-portability/offboarding guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.
